useFor: Arranging the children of one element of the app's own in a row or a stack, aligned, sized and divided, where no component already does.

combineWith.how: A gap step on the row or column replaces its 8px default.
.sedna-fill gives a .text-truncate inside it the min-width it needs to cut.
Actions at the far end of a row of the app's own, after a .sedna-push, the primary last.
.sedna-shrink-0 on an avatar or a badge that keeps its size beside text that gives way.

notFor.text: A main column beside an aside
A list of records with rules between the rows
Filters and actions above a list

useFor: Changing the gap inside a row or a column, and adding or removing a top or bottom margin on one element.

combineWith.how: The gap steps override the 8px gap of a .sedna-row or a .sedna-col.
.sedna-mt-0 flushes one child of .page out of the page's own rhythm.

notFor.text: Space between the fields of a form

useFor: How one line reads: where it sits, how loud it is, whether its digits line up, and what happens when it is longer than its box, with a show more for a clamped block.

combineWith.how: In a row, .sedna-fill around the text gives a truncation room to cut.
The show more toggle is a .btn-bare--link under the clamped block.

notFor.text: A column of figures in a table
The title and second line of a list row
Prose the app did not write

useFor: Text read by a screen reader and not drawn, a block that is present but unavailable or reloading, and what reaches paper.

combineWith.how: .visually-hidden finishes a button's name where the screen shows only a count or a short word.
The sparkle-only AI label is named by a .visually-hidden span.
.sedna-busy with aria-busy="true" on a card whose content is reloading.

notFor.text: A button that cannot be used
A region loading for the first time
A link that jumps past the navigation

useFor: A block that scrolls on its own instead of growing the page, down or sideways, with the cut edge faded.

combineWith.how: A scroller with a height around a .table--sticky keeps the headings in view while the rows scroll.
A log in a .code-block takes .sedna-scroll and its own --scroll-max.
An agenda in a scroller with a height keeps each day's heading pinned.
A row held near the edge of a scroller scrolls it while it is dragged.

notFor.text: A table wide because of its many columns
A table on a narrow screen

useFor: Holding a bar of the app's own clear of the screen the device has taken: a home indicator, a notch, a rounded corner.

combineWith.how: The host page's viewport meta carries viewport-fit=cover, or every inset is 0px.
The class goes on the element that carries the background, here the bar's card body, not on a wrapper.

notFor.text: The phone's bottom bar of places
